title: eval-harness-per-prompt-ci-quality-gate
author: Priya Desai
description: Add per-prompt quality gating to eval-harness CI. This PR introduces a GitHub Actions job and supporting eval-harness code to compute per-prompt quality metrics and fail the PR if regressions exceed configured thresholds. Motivation: several incidents showed model rollout regressions were noisy at aggregate level but obvious when looked at per-prompt; we want an automated guard in CI so regressions are caught earlier. High level: 1) GH Action workflow eval-quality.yaml runs eval-harness against a snapshot of prompt-sets for changed models/routes. 2) A new quality_gate module computes per-prompt deltas and compares against thresholds stored in eval-harness/config/prompt_quality.yaml. 3) Reporter outputs an artifact (per-prompt-diff.json + human-readable markdown) and posts a summary as a check annotation. 4) Opt-out label skip-eval-gate allows experimental PRs to bypass the gate. Checklist: - [x] Add GH Action workflow and matrix for affected models - [x] Implement per-prompt comparison logic + thresholds - [x] Add tests for gating logic and reporter - [x] Docs for maintainers (docs/ci/eval-quality.md) - [x] Add Linear link and signal to oncall for flaky gates Notes: thresholds are conservative to avoid false positives; gate is enabled for redwood repo by default and scoped to PRs that touch eval-config/prompt-sets or model adapters. See linked Linear items for tuning plan. This description is a single continuous string as required.
